authorization: Operator requested all proposed eligibility, 5-minute screen and conditional independent 15-minute holdout steps.
selection: Refresh previous Senate/Michigan/Georgia Governor/House hints in order; take first three open, valid two-sided pairs. If fewer than two, bounded existing local catalogue hints and official public metadata may supply additional distinct proposals up to twelve total. Retain all exclusions. No inference.
ranking: Among full qualifiers, descending minimum half-window wall coverage, then full wall coverage, then stable pair ID. Freeze best two; no substitutions.
stop_rule: No holdout if fewer than two screen qualifiers, audit/preflight failure or changed definitions. Stop at original fixed deadlines, no repeat or extension.
unchanged_settings: Atomic final commit, WAL/FULL, inband-snapshot, two-second age/skew gates, existing metadata/grids, snapshot/reconnect budgets.
denominators: Recorded sample percentages plus planned one-second slots/missing samples; full wall window and both equal halves.
telemetry: Existing raw/event/receive journals measure availability, pending barriers and recoveries. No live instrumentation change. Any post-capture commit-cost probe is isolated offline and separately labeled.
